Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sh As Shape
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 110, 20, 120, 40)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Range("A1").Font.Size = 30
    Case 1
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Range("A3").Font.Size = 30
    Case 2
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Range("A3").WrapText = True: ws.Range("A3").Value = "one two three four five six seven"
    Case 3
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Rows(1).Insert
    Case 4
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Rows(3).Insert
    Case 5
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Rows("3:4").Insert
    Case 6
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Rows(1).Delete
    Case 7
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Rows(3).Delete
    Case 8
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Rows("2:5").Delete
    Case 9
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Columns(1).Insert
    Case 10
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Columns(4).Insert
    Case 11
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Columns(1).Delete
    Case 12
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Columns(4).Delete
    Case 13
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Columns("C:E").Delete
    Case 14
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Range("A3").EntireRow.Insert
    Case 15
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Range("D1").Insert xlShiftToRight
    Case 16
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Range("D3").Insert xlShiftToRight
    Case 17
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Range("D3").Insert xlShiftDown
    Case 18
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Range("D3").Delete xlShiftUp
    Case 19
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Range("A3:Z3").Insert xlShiftDown
    Case 20
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Range("A1").Font.Size = 30
    Case 21
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Range("A3").Font.Size = 30
    Case 22
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Range("A3").WrapText = True: ws.Range("A3").Value = "one two three four five six seven"
    Case 23
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Rows(1).Insert
    Case 24
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Rows(3).Insert
    Case 25
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Rows("3:4").Insert
    Case 26
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Rows(1).Delete
    Case 27
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Rows(3).Delete
    Case 28
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Rows("2:5").Delete
    Case 29
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Columns(1).Insert
    Case 30
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Columns(4).Insert
    Case 31
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Columns(1).Delete
    Case 32
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Columns(4).Delete
    Case 33
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Columns("C:E").Delete
    Case 34
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Range("A3").EntireRow.Insert
    Case 35
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Range("D1").Insert xlShiftToRight
    Case 36
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Range("D3").Insert xlShiftToRight
    Case 37
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Range("D3").Insert xlShiftDown
    Case 38
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Range("D3").Delete xlShiftUp
    Case 39
        sh.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Range("A3:Z3").Insert xlShiftDown
    Case 40
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Range("A1").Font.Size = 30
    Case 41
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Range("A3").Font.Size = 30
    Case 42
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Range("A3").WrapText = True: ws.Range("A3").Value = "one two three four five six seven"
    Case 43
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Rows(1).Insert
    Case 44
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Rows(3).Insert
    Case 45
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Rows("3:4").Insert
    Case 46
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Rows(1).Delete
    Case 47
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Rows(3).Delete
    Case 48
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Rows("2:5").Delete
    Case 49
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Columns(1).Insert
    Case 50
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Columns(4).Insert
    Case 51
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Columns(1).Delete
    Case 52
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Columns(4).Delete
    Case 53
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Columns("C:E").Delete
    Case 54
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Range("A3").EntireRow.Insert
    Case 55
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Range("D1").Insert xlShiftToRight
    Case 56
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Range("D3").Insert xlShiftToRight
    Case 57
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Range("D3").Insert xlShiftDown
    Case 58
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Range("D3").Delete xlShiftUp
    Case 59
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Range("A3:Z3").Insert xlShiftDown
    End Select
    If ws.Shapes.Count = 0 Then
        Tried = "ok gone"
    Else
        Tried = "ok " & sh.Left & "," & sh.Top & "," & sh.Width & "," & sh.Height & "," & sh.TopLeftCell.Address(0, 0) & "," & sh.BottomRightCell.Address(0, 0)
    End If
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    For i = 0 To 59
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
